visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host and a female host stand in a modern, brightly lit lobby of the Hey Song Zhongli Plant. They are dressed in casual clothes, smiling broadly and clapping their hands towards the camera. The background features a large LED screen displaying the program title and plant logo. (2) The camera shifts to close-up shots of the male host, who has a distinctive small ponytail. He uses wide hand gestures and exhibits exaggerated facial expressions, including wide eyes and an open mouth, as he explains the history of the company. Yellow and black variety-style text overlays appear around him. (3) The scene transitions to an indoor lab setting where the hosts, now wearing white caps, stand next to an older man in a professional lab coat. The older man holds a clear plastic bottle filled with a dark brown beverage, Sarsaparilla, showcasing it to the camera while the hosts look on with curiosity. (4) Rapid-fire shots of an industrial production line are shown. Blue-capped bottles move quickly along green conveyor belts. Complex machinery with transparent protective casings and various warning signs are illuminated by bright, cool-toned factory lights. (5) On the factory floor, workers wearing white uniforms, caps, and large over-ear noise protection headphones are seen operating the machinery. The camera captures them moving quickly, reaching into the machinery to adjust bottles, while various text overlays like "Mechanical Failure" appear in bright red. (6) The scene moves outdoors to a walkway where three workers are pushing a silver metal cart loaded with crates of bottled water and sports drinks. They are walking towards a large red and white branded vending machine. The lighting is natural daylight in an outdoor campus setting with trees in the background. (7) Two workers are seen interacting with the open interior of a vending machine, trying to slot bottles into the high-reaching dispensers. One worker reaches high while the other points and laughs. The female host looks frustrated while trying to help. (8) The final scene shows the two hosts and several plant employees standing in a row in front of several large white delivery trucks with the company logo. They all raise their hands and cheer towards the camera as the sun sets in the background, creating a warm, golden glow.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a burst of high-energy, fast-paced electronic pop music accompanied by the loud, rhythmic sound of multiple people clapping in a resonant indoor space. A male voice yells "Great!" with extremely high arousal and a positive, welcoming tone. (2) A transition is marked by a sharp "ding" sound effect as a female voice speaks at a fast rate with an excited pitch. This is immediately followed by a cartoon-style "whoosh" transition sound and rhythmic electronic drums maintaining a steady 128 BPM tempo. (3) The background noise shifts to a low, continuous mechanical hum of factory machinery. A male voice adopts a more narrative, storytelling tone with lower pitch variability. A subtle "clink" sound of plastic bottles hitting each other is audible in the mid-frequency range. (4) A loud alarm-like synthesizer sound effect triggers a new phase, signifying a dramatic shift. Tense, cinematic orchestral music with heavy percussion swells in volume, mimicking an action sequence. Shouting voices are heard in the background with high vocal tension and rapid speech. (5) The music transitions into a comedic, bouncy tuba-led track. Sounds of rustling plastic and metallic clicking are heard as people talk in a casual, conversational tone with moderate volume. The female voice exhibits a rising intonation suggesting a question. (6) The video ends with a triumphant, high-arousal chorus of multiple voices cheering and clapping. The BGM swells to a loud, bright finish with sharp synthesizer chords and a heavy final drum hit, concluding with a standard broadcast-style fade out.

It aims to showcase the brand's production scale, product variety (Sarsaparilla, FIN), and the humorous challenges workers face, ultimately building brand affinity through entertainment.
